en_title: Robert Pattinson Cast as James Bond in Next 007 Movie
cn_title: 罗伯特·帕丁森获选在下一部007电影中饰演詹姆斯·邦德
opus_summary: 007官方社交媒体账号确认，罗伯特·帕丁森将在丹尼斯·维伦纽瓦执导的新片中饰演詹姆斯·邦德，并公布了首张形象照。据《好莱坞报道者》报道，维伦纽瓦直到昨天上午才通知帕丁森获得该角色，制片人艾米·帕斯卡尔据称致电了落选者。

paragraphs.en: After years of rumors and speculation, Twilight and The Batman star Robert Pattinson has officially been cast as James Bond in Denis Villeneuve's 007 movie .
paragraphs.cn: 经过多年的传闻和猜测，《暮光之城》和《新蝙蝠侠》主演罗伯特·帕丁森已正式获选在丹尼斯·维伦纽瓦的007电影中饰演詹姆斯·邦德。

paragraphs.en: Official 007 social media accounts confirmed the news today. Additional details about Pattinson's Bond debut remain unclear, but the announcement post did at least come with a first look, which you can see below.
paragraphs.cn: 007官方社交媒体账号今天证实了这一消息。有关帕丁森首次饰演邦德的更多细节仍不明朗，但公告帖至少附上了一张首发图片，你可以在下方看到。

paragraphs.en: "James Bond is one of the most legendary characters in cinema, and to be entrusted with 007 is the honour of a lifetime," Pattinson said in a statement . "I'm deeply grateful to Denis, Amy, David, Tanya, and everyone at Amazon MGM Studios for their belief in me. To say this role is a dream come true is an understatement. I couldn’t be more excited about this partnership and the work ahead with this fantastic team."
paragraphs.cn: 「詹姆斯·邦德是电影史上最具传奇色彩的角色之一，能被托付饰演007是我一生的荣幸，」帕丁森在一份声明中说。「我非常感谢丹尼斯、艾米、戴维、塔尼娅以及Amazon MGM Studios的所有人对我的信任。说这个角色让我梦想成真都不足以表达我的心情。我对这次合作以及今后与这个出色团队一起开展的工作感到无比兴奋。」

paragraphs.en: Villeneuve also released a statement on choosing Pattinson to play 007:
paragraphs.cn: 维伦纽瓦也就选择帕丁森饰演007发表了声明：

paragraphs.en: "Before anything else, I want to express my deep gratitude to the remarkable actors who joined us on this journey. We were surrounded by extraordinary talent, but there can only be one 007. I am overjoyed to welcome Robert Pattinson as our new James Bond. He has the timeless soul of 007 and brings a spirit that is completely new. I cannot wait to begin."
paragraphs.cn: 「首先，我想向与我们一起踏上这段旅程的杰出演员们表达深深的感谢。我们身边汇聚了非凡的人才，但007只能有一位。我非常高兴地欢迎罗伯特·帕丁森成为我们新一任詹姆斯·邦德。他拥有007历久弥新的灵魂，同时带来了一种全新的精神。我迫不及待想要开始了。」

paragraphs.en: The Hollywood Reporter shared additional details about Pattinson's casting and how the news was kept under lock and key in a new report. Contenders are said to have been judged on stunts, camera presence, and dialogue while testing for the role.
paragraphs.cn: 好莱坞报道者在一篇新报道中分享了有关帕丁森获选以及这一消息如何被严格保密的更多细节。据称，竞争者在试演该角色时，特技表现、镜头表现力和台词表现都受到了评判。

paragraphs.en: As the competition for Bond stayed behind closed doors, Amazon reportedly became even more secretive after actually making its decision. In fact, THR reported that, while everyone online patiently awaited updates, it wasn't until yesterday morning that Villeneuve contacted Pattinson to inform him that he had landed the part. Producer Amy Pascal reportedly called the runner-ups.
paragraphs.cn: 邦德一角的竞争始终在闭门状态下进行，据报道，Amazon在实际作出决定后变得更加保密。事实上，好莱坞报道者报道称，就在网上所有人耐心等待最新消息时，维伦纽瓦直到昨天早上才联系帕丁森，告知他已获得这一角色。据报道，制片人艾米·帕斯卡尔给落选的候选人打了电话。

paragraphs.en: Even those who have been keeping up with all of the latest updates on Amazon MGM's hunt for Bond recognize Pattinson's casting arrives as a last-minute twist. Although the Dune and Arrival director was confirmed to helm the next iteration of film's legendary British secret agent in mid-2025, questions about who would adopt the 007 mantle have swirled since Daniel Craig stepped away from the part following the release of No Time to Die in 2021.
paragraphs.cn: 即便是一直关注Amazon MGM寻找邦德人选全部最新进展的人，也承认帕丁森获选是最后时刻的转折。虽然这位《沙丘》和《降临》的导演已于2025年年中确认执导这位传奇英国电影特工的下一次登场，但自丹尼尔·克雷格在《007：无暇赴死》于2021年上映后告别这一角色以来，谁将接过007衣钵的问题一直众说纷纭。

paragraphs.en: As unsubstantiated internet rumors throwing out names like Tom Holland and Idris Elba subsided, more concrete background details on the hunt eventually emerged. Callum Turner and Jacob Elordi were two faces talked about earlier on, with Slow Horses star Jack Lowden then entering the conversation courtesy of Gary Oldman shortly after. Finally, just last month, Amazon reportedly narrowed its search to a small collection of actors , including Lowden, Turner, and Josh O'Connor.
paragraphs.cn: 随着那些提及汤姆·赫兰德和伊德里斯·艾尔巴等名字、未经证实的网络传闻逐渐平息，有关选角的更多具体背景细节最终浮出水面。卡勒姆·特纳和雅各布·艾洛蒂是早期被讨论的两个人选，此后不久，得益于加里·奥德曼，《流人》主演杰克·劳登也进入了人们的讨论。最后，就在上个月，据报道Amazon将搜索范围缩小到一小批演员，包括劳登、特纳和乔什·奥康纳。

paragraphs.en: Then, out of the darkness came Pattinson.
paragraphs.cn: 随后，帕丁森从暗处现身。
